* The Size & Scale Estimation Agent will estimate the size and scale of each entity relative to the others, including the height of the table and the width of the chairs.

* The Graph Formalization Agent will construct a formal graph representation of the scene, incorporating the extracted entities, attributes, and relationships.
* The Graph Formalization Agent will ensure the graph is structured and consistent, ready for further processing or visualization.
* The plan will be executed in a sequential manner, with each agent building upon the output of the previous agent to create a comprehensive representation of the scene.
